Check_Trigger_Enabled.description: App-setting kill-switch (2026-08-03, PLAN.md 17.7): the platform's per-workflow enable/disable API doesn't work reliably here, so this trigger always stays platform-Enabled but the engine only runs when SCHEDULED_TRIGGER_ENABLED is (case-insensitively) 'true'. toLower() handles both casings in use: Bicep's string(bool) -> 'True'/'False', az logicapp config appsettings set -> lowercase. Missing setting = disabled (safe-by-default). NOTE (2026-08-10): a prior, longer version of this description exceeded the 1024-char action-description limit (ActionDescriptionTooLong), which silently kept this workflow on an old pre-gate version with no gate at all - keep this description well under 1024 chars.
